# COFI TRADERS

> COFI TRADERS is a Costa Rican specialty green coffee sourcing and export company. We connect international roasters with traceable micro-lots from small producers in the Brunca region of Costa Rica. We operate as an origin broker — pricing is negotiated directly between buyer and producer, with COFI TRADERS facilitating the relationship and logistics.

## About

- Founded by Maikol Araya in Sabalito, Coto Brus, Costa Rica
- Focused on the Brunca region: Coto Brus and Pérez Zeledón
- All lots are single-origin, fully traceable, 2025 harvest
- Minimum order: 60 kg per lot (shared container splits available)
- EUDR-ready documentation available
- Bilingual service: English and Spanish

## Current Lots — 2025 Harvest

### MILENIO BLACK CHERRY
- Variety: Milenio H10
- Process: Anaerobic fermentation (Black Cherry)
- Altitude: 1,600 masl
- Producer: Lica Torres — Cerro Buena Vista, Rivas, Pérez Zeledón
- Tasting notes: Dark fruit, hibiscus, chocolate
- Lot ID: CBV-BC-ANA-2025

### ETÍOPE 47 WHITE HONEY
- Variety: SL28 (locally known as Etíope 47)
- Process: White Honey
- Altitude: 1,800 masl
- Producer: Lica Torres — Cerro Buena Vista, Rivas, Pérez Zeledón
- Tasting notes: Peach, bergamot, honey
- Lot ID: CBV-ET47-WH-2025

### MILENIO RED HONEY
- Variety: Milenio H10
- Process: Red Honey
- Altitude: 1,600 masl
- Producer: Lica Torres — Cerro Buena Vista, Rivas, Pérez Zeledón
- Tasting notes: Red fruits, honey, plum, silky body
- Lot ID: CBV-MH10-RH-2025

### VENECIA HONEY
- Variety: Venecia
- Process: Honey
- Altitude: 1,300 masl
- Producer: Don Humberto — El Arrempujón, Las Mellizas de Sabalito, Coto Brus
- Tasting notes: Mandarin, peach, caramel, cacao, sugarcane honey
- Lot ID: AEA-VEN-H-2025

### CENTROAMERICANO NATURAL
- Variety: Centroamericano
- Process: Natural
- Altitude: 1,300 masl
- Producer: Don Humberto — El Arrempujón, Las Mellizas de Sabalito, Coto Brus
- Tasting notes: Red fruits, plum, red wine, cacao, creamy
- Lot ID: AEA-CA-NAT-2025

## Producers

### Lica Torres
- Micro-beneficio: Cerro Buena Vista
- Location: Rivas, Pérez Zeledón, Brunca, Costa Rica
- Altitude: 1,600–1,800 masl
- Lots: MILENIO BLACK CHERRY, ETÍOPE 47 WHITE HONEY, MILENIO RED HONEY
- Known for experimental anaerobic and honey processes

### Don Humberto
- Micro-beneficio: El Arrempujón
- Location: Las Mellizas de Sabalito, Coto Brus, Brunca, Costa Rica
- Altitude: 1,300–1,400 masl
- Lots: VENECIA HONEY, CENTROAMERICANO NATURAL
- Known for traditional local varieties and careful natural processing

## Samples

- Price: $50 USD per sample
- Contents: 300g green coffee + technical data sheet
- Shipping time: approximately 1 week depending on destination
- Limit: 1 sample per lot per buyer
- The $50 sample cost is credited toward the first full lot order

## How to Buy

1. Browse the catalog at cofi.cr/catalog.html
2. Request a sample at cofi.cr/samples.html
3. Cup and evaluate
4. Contact to arrange full lot order and logistics
